name: Famichiki Counter
author: fbnlrz
description: Tally every Famichiki you eat on your trip — FamilyMart Japan's legendary fried-chicken snack, counted right on your dashboard.

settings.label: Daily goal
settings.hint: How many Famichiki a day you are aiming for. 0 turns the goal off.

settings.label: Milestone notifications
settings.hint: Send a TREK notification when you hit 10, 25, 50, 100, 250 or 500 Famichiki.

settings.label: Log to trip budget
settings.hint: Book every Famichiki as a budget item on the trip that is running. Needs the Costs addon and budget edit rights.

settings.label: Price per Famichiki
settings.hint: Used for the running total and for budget items. FamilyMart charged around 198 yen at the time of writing.

settings.label: Currency
settings.hint: Three-letter code for the price above.
